Researchers have discovered a rare trait in animals in the wild – Mexican hairy dwarf porcupines glow in various colours in the dark.

    "...the live animals did so with greater intensity and in different colors (blue, green, and yellow) compared with the museum specimens, which had an ambiguous yellow-green photoluminescence,”
